description: Comprehensive fourth-component study extending the existing integrated Round 07. Existing equal, heavy, and Throughput-Service anchor-preserving case IDs are retained so completed v0.9.4 runs can be reused; twenty new single-anchor and pair/group cases complete the 32-case design.

common.reward_normalization: All cases keep positive_scale=1.0 and normalized positive weights. No delta rewards, penalties, Lagrangian multipliers, rules, candidate filters, or forced HARQ selections are enabled. The eight regimes distinguish equal addition, component dominance, single-anchor dependence, and pair/group dependence.

cases.label: Equal-quarter: Throughput-deficit service
cases.hypothesis: X tạo lợi ích biên gì khi được thêm bằng trọng số với T–J–S? Mục tiêu riêng của Throughput-deficit service là nâng nhóm UE có throughput thấp hơn mức trung bình.
